verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents native OTLP ingestion (gRPC/HTTP protobuf/JSON) and encourages instrumenting with vendor-neutral OpenTelemetry SDKs rather than proprietary agents, explicitly supporting the 'instrument once, switch backend' model; it also documents migration guidance away from its legacy Beelines toward OTel. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actually switching backends without code changes, and more detail on parity of features (e.g., metrics/logs) across OTel vs proprietary paths.
